synopsis: The corpus consistently specifies an NVIDIA RTX 3000-series GPU or better with at least 16 GB of VRAM for CARLA on Unreal Engine 5 [f8469, f16195, f8850]. Chapter 11 additionally requires 130 GB of disk space [f8469, f8850]. One Chapter 11 entry specifies Ubuntu 22.04 or Windows 11, while the glossary restates only the GPU and VRAM requirement; these entries are complementary, not conflicting [f8469, f16195, f8850].

relations.note: Both specify an RTX 3000-series GPU minimum with 16 GB VRAM.
Both state the same GPU generation and minimum VRAM requirement.
Duplicate hardware requirements; f8469 also specifies supported operating systems.
